mapper.sql: select fr.receivable_id, fr.sale_order_id, so.order_no as sale_order_no, coalesce(fr.customer_id, so.customer_id) as customer_id, mc.customer_name, fr.amount_due, fr.amount_paid, fr.amount_due - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0) as remain_amount, fr.status, fr.due_date, case when fr.status in ('unpaid', 'partial') and fr.due_date is not null and fr.due_date < curdate() then datediff(curdate(), date(fr.due_date)) else 0 end as overdue_days, fr.create_by, fr.create_time, fr.update_by, fr.update_time, fr.remark from fin_receivable fr left join wms_sale_order so on so.sale_order_id = fr.sale_order_id left join md_customer mc on mc.customer_id = coalesce(fr.customer_id, so.customer_id) left join sys_user su on su.user_name = coalesce(nullif(fr.create_by, ''), so.create_by) and su.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select fr.receivable_id, fr.sale_order_id, fr.customer_id, fr.amount_due, fr.amount_paid, fr.amount_due - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0) as remain_amount, fr.status, fr.due_date, fr.create_by, fr.create_time, fr.update_by, fr.update_time, fr.remark from fin_receivable fr where fr.receivable_id = #{receivableId} for update
where fr.sale_order_id = #{saleOrderId} and ifnull(fr.amount_due, 0) >= 0 order by fr.receivable_id asc limit 1

and fr.sale_order_id = #{saleOrderId}
and so.order_no like concat('%', #{saleOrderNo}, '%')
and coalesce(fr.customer_id, so.customer_id) = #{customerId}
and fr.status in ('unpaid', 'partial') and fr.amount_due - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0) > 0 and fr.due_date is not null and fr.due_date < curdate()
and fr.status = #{status}
and fr.due_date >= concat(#{params.beginDueDate}, ' 00:00:00')
and fr.due_date < date_add(concat(#{params.endDueDate}, ' 00:00:00'), interval 1 day)
and fr.status in ('unpaid', 'partial')
and fr.due_date is null
and fr.due_date is not null and fr.due_date >= curdate()
and fr.due_date is not null and datediff(curdate(), fr.due_date) between 1 and 30
and fr.due_date is not null and datediff(curdate(), fr.due_date) between 31 and 60
and fr.due_date is not null and datediff(curdate(), fr.due_date) > 60
and fr.due_date >= #{params.beginTime}
and fr.due_date <= concat(#{params.endTime}, ' 23:59:59')
${params.dataScope}
order by fr.receivable_id desc
where coalesce(fr.customer_id, so.customer_id) = #{customerId} and fr.status in ('unpaid', 'partial') and fr.amount_due - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0) > 0 order by fr.receivable_id desc

where fr.status in ('unpaid', 'partial') and fr.amount_due - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0) > 0 and fr.due_date is not null and fr.due_date >= curdate() and fr.due_date < date_add(date_add(curdate(), interval ifnull(#{remindDays}, 7) day), interval 1 day) order by fr.due_date asc, fr.receivable_id desc
where fr.status in ('unpaid', 'partial') and fr.amount_due - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0) > 0 and fr.due_date is not null and fr.due_date < curdate() order by overdue_days desc, fr.receivable_id desc

select ifnull(sum(fr.amount_due - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0)), 0) from fin_receivable fr left join wms_sale_order so on so.sale_order_id = fr.sale_order_id where coalesce(fr.customer_id, so.customer_id) = #{customerId} and fr.status in ('unpaid', 'partial') and fr.amount_due - ifnull(fr.amount_paid, 0) > 0
